items.title: FMCG sector set for steady Q4 on rural demand and volume growth
items.description: The FMCG sector anticipates a steady March quarter, buoyed by stable rural demand and urban recovery, despite subdued pricing in some segments. While raw material costs were supportive for most of the quarter, recent increases in crude-linked inputs may impact margins. Companies with strong execution and premium portfolios are expected to lead performance.

items.title: HCL Tech Q4 Preview: Will growth surprise investors after weak Wipro earnings?
items.description: HCL Technologies is poised for a mixed March quarter, anticipating steady year-on-year growth but a sequential dip due to software seasonality and rising costs. While revenue is projected to climb annually, a slight quarterly decline is expected. Margins may face pressure from wage hikes and restructuring. Investors await insights on future guidance and AI's impact.

items.title: Groww, world’s most expensive broking stock, to face earnings test today after doubling from IPO price
items.description: Billionbrains Garage Ventures (Groww) is set to report earnings Monday, with investors questioning whether its rich valuation is justified. The stock has surged 29% this year. Analysts expect net income to double to Rs 6.6 billion, but its 43x forward P/E—higher than Robinhood, Interactive Brokers and Angel One—will keep scrutiny on the sustainability of growth.
